item.tib: rig 'dzin chen po stong rgyang mthu chen gyi dbang khrid ye shes rang gsal
item.coloph: de ltar dbang chog ye shes rang gsal zhes bya ba 'di yang / skye ba sngon rabs nas dam tshig che ba'i snying gi grogs po dge rgan shes rab phun tshogs kyis/ rin chen gnyis pa'i 'khor lo dang / dar dkar dri med chun pos sna drangs te/ sgo gsum rtse gcig tu bskul ba dang*/ de rjes btsun chung g.yung drung phun tshogs dang / sngags 'chang dpal sdis gnyis kyis yang yang legs pa'i snang bas bsus te/ bla ma bdag la brda' thabs su brgyud pa bzhin du/ snyigs dus kyi skabs su bab pa'i tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/ gsang mtshan g.yung drung thog (thogs) med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag gis sa lug zla ba 7pa'i tshes la spel ba'o//
